name: Short-name self references — Maarika and Óin
notes: Fourth sweep list (2026-10-06). A card that gives its full name once and its short name afterwards ("Maarika, Brutal Gladiator must be blocked if able. … Maarika has indestructible") only had the full name read as itself, so the second sentence did nothing; and \b never matched before the accented letter in "Óin". Both now parse. The first word of a name is not treated as a short name when it is a type word (Rat Colony's "each other Rat").
